A '''reanimated dagannoth''' can be spawned by casting the [[Arceuus spellbook|Arceuus spell]] [[Expert Reanimation]] on an [[ensouled dagannoth head]]. Reanimation can be cast on any ensouled head within an 31x31 area where that head was dropped by a monster. This will work indefinitely, even if the ensouled head is picked up, so long as it is not put into the [[bank]], [[trade]] screen, [[Grand Exchange]], or [[price checker]]. If the player has put the head into the bank, trade screen, Grand Exchange, or price checker, the reanimation spell will only work within range of the [[Dark Altar]]. Killing the creature grants 936 [[Prayer]] [[experience]].
